item.title: Strawberry Beer Margaritas
item.description: These beer margaritas get a flavorful twist with the addition of tequila-soaked strawberries!

item.title: Oat Milk
item.description: This vegan oat milk is a perfect solution for your coffee, cereal, or just satisfying that cookie-dunking craving.

item.title: Missionary's Downfall
item.description: Fresh mint joins rum, fruit juice, peach schnapps, and honey syrup for this summer-ready, tropical cocktail.

item.title: Jim Beam Yule Nog
item.description: Rich, creamy eggnog is the base of this tasty yule log cocktail made with Jim Beam Bourbon and butterscotch liqueur. It tastes just like the holidays!

item.title: Holiday Poinsettia Cocktail
item.description: This beautiful poinsettia cocktail recipe is made with Champagne and a splash of cranberry juice. It is a delicious way to celebrate the festive season.

item.title: Holiday Mule Mocktail
item.description: Add your favorite fermented ginger beer to homemade spiced cranberry shrub for a non-alcoholic Moscow mule worth remembering.

item.title: Guava Mojito
item.description: Passion fruit rum and guava nectar bring a fruity flavor to traditional mojitos using this super simple recipe perfect for warm evenings.

item.title: Grilled Lemon Limeade
item.description: Lemons and limes are charred and juiced, then mixed with sugar to create this grilled fruit limeade drink that is perfect for summer.

item.title: Fall Sangria
item.description: Mix fruits, apple cider, cinnamon, triple sec, white wine, and soda water together for a delicious fall sangria cocktail.

item.title: Eggnog Milkshake
item.description: A seasonal milkshake made with eggnog and butter pecan ice cream. Top with whipped cream and dust with cinnamon to be extra festive.

item.title: Cold Brew and Tonic
item.description: Refreshing in the morning, or any time of day, this easy cold brew and tonic drink is sure to pep you up!

item.title: Authentic Horchata
item.description: Fragrant cinnamon and vanilla infuse this authentic horchata with Spanish flair for a sweet, refreshing summer "rice milk" you can make in advance!

item.title: Apple Pie Mixed Drinks
item.description: Apple juice and apple cider blend with Everclear® and a stick of cinnamon in this yummy apple pie cocktail, perfect for gift giving.

item.title: Tito's Berry Good Punch
item.description: Serve this refreshing, fruity, and berry-packed Tito's vodka punch at your next summer party and impress your guests.

item.title: Mezcal Mule
item.description: This mezcal mule is a twist on Moscow mule made with mezcal instead of vodka. Mezcal has a wonderful smoky flavor that complements the ginger beer.

item.title: Ginger-Hibiscus Sparkler
item.description: Spicy ginger liqueur, nonalcoholic ginger beer, and sweet-tart hibiscus provide all the buzz you need.

item.title: Spinach-Berry Smoothie
item.description: If you're trying to add more spinach to your diet, try this yummy smoothie with blueberries, blackberries, and light sour cream. Feel free to use other berries to your liking.

item.title: Red Apple Milkshake
item.description: You will love this yummy, refreshing shake! All skim milk and no ice cream makes for a guilt-free treat.

item.title: White Sangria with Kiwi
item.description: Slices of kiwi fruit add a tropical flavor and color to this not-too-sweet white wine sangria.

item.title: Blackberry-Mint Julep Margarita
item.description: The Kentucky Derby meets Cinco de Mayo in this refreshing blackberry-mint julep margarita cocktail that will surely delight you and your guests.

item.title: Sunset Rum Punch
item.description: Full of fresh citrus juice, a touch of almond syrup, and plenty of good rum, a mug of this punch is great for watching sunsets with friends.

item.title: The Lisa-tini Martini
item.description: Lemon vodka, orange liqueur, and champagne are the key ingredients in this bubbly martini.

item.title: Chef John's "Sunset" Michelada
item.description: Use homemade vegetable juice or store-bought tomato juice to make this Michelada: a spicy, savory, tangy, and amazingly refreshing beer cocktail.

item.title: White Sangria with Berries
item.description: This white sangria made with berries and fresh peaches is an easy, summer-ready drink for any party or gathering.
